quarterly_data.quarter: Wacker Chemie press release: Capital Markets Day 2026: REFOCUS - driving selective (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capital Markets Day 2026 (REFOCUS): new financial ambitions of growth above global economic growth, an EBITDA margin of 15 percent (plus or minus 2 percentage points) and ROCE above 10 percent; the PACE program will save more than EUR 300 million a year starting in 2028; investments are to total EUR 300 million to EUR 400 million per year in the coming years, below depreciation and amortization, focused on electronics, healthcare and mobility applications. CEO Christian Hartel: 'We currently expect third-quarter EBITDA to be on par with that of the second quarter'; the chemical business is stable to slightly better than in Q2, while solar-grade polysilicon remains challenging.
quarterly_data.figure: EBITDA margin 15% (plus or minus 2 pp); ROCE above 10%; investments EUR 300 million to EUR 400 million a year

quarterly_data.quarter: Wacker Chemie press release: Capital Markets Day 2026: REFOCUS - driving selective (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Polysilicon (Capital Markets Day release): Wacker says nearly half of all computer chips produced worldwide already use its hyperpure polysilicon; the division aims to extend its market leadership in ultra-pure polysilicon for semiconductor applications, with the new semiconductor-grade polysilicon line at Burghausen, on stream since last year, playing a key role. Silicones has established new production capacity in Karlovy Vary (Czech Republic) and Panagarh (India) in recent years.
quarterly_data.figure: nearly half of all chips use Wacker hyperpure polysilicon
